rows.en: ...Gaddess!! You've got nowhere left to run!!
Hahahaha!! You fell for it hook, line and sinker.
You! You were luring us here all along!!
Fuhahahahaha!!! I did it!! The plan was a success.
Well, well! Not bad at all, are ya?
Ah, he went to Veda, y'know? Said he's gonna take care of the rest of the rats.
Understood. I'll leave this to you. I'm going to back up Reborns.
...You're gonna die, y'know? Anyone who lays eyes on me!!
Hey there, Gaddess! You're the one who fell for it!
Your moves looked pretty fishy to me, so I broke off from the formation and went my own way.
Don't tell me you thought we were just playing tag without a plan!
Don't go underestimating the great Deathscythe's Hyper Jammer, got it!?
...You punks... I listened quietly, and you've got the nerve to make a fool of me!
I'll teach you that cheap tricks like that don't work on me!!!
Heh... You should've stepped in from the start, Arche. Well then, I'm leaving this to you.
You got it! Go keep the boss safe!
Mission accepted!! Combat level, target confirmed!
Got it!! Like I'd let her get away!!
Roger!! We'll catch up to her for sure!!
Understood!! We'll catch up to her, I promise!!
Understood!! We'll catch up to her, I promise!!
Got it!! She ain't gettin' away from me!!
Leave it to me!! Why, that little...!! I'm gonna nab her!!
Got it!! We'll catch up to her, count on it!!
Got it!! We'll catch up to her, count on it!!
Got it!! We'll catch up to her, count on it!!
Got it!! We'll catch up to her for sure!!
Got it!! We'll catch up to her, count on it!!
...Like hell I'll let you! Gaga! Go!
We can at least buy some time too!!
Our strategy: hit them first, before they can ram us!!

notes.note: #0.206-220: 15-copy leader block 'Sandrock...!!' continued from story_136; identical EN.
Gaddess (f per glossary) taunting; feminine 'kashira' -> 'Are you so sure about that?'.
Unlabelled; a Gaga's Trans-Am shout, matching story_136.
Unlabelled; almost certainly Birth hit by the Gaga (Ankh shouts 'Birth!!' next).
#0.241-255: 15-row leader grunt block, identical to story_136 #0.158-172; same EN copied.
'Nokori no nezumi' = the remaining rats (Reborns' 'three rats', i.e. Seravee's group). 'Veda' kept as established.
??? = Deathscythe Hell (revealed #0.268). 'Sou wa ikuka' -> 'Like hell you are!!' (Gaddess just said she is going to back up Reborns). Avoided 'Not so fast', which is Arche's catchphrase.
Duo's signature line (whoever sees me dies); kept the tail-end structure of the source.
'Gaddess-san yo' sarcastic; -san dropped per style, tone carried by 'Hey there'.
Rhetorical 'to omotta no ka yo!' kept with '!' as in the source.
'Hyper Jammer' = Deathscythe's established English name for its jamming system (not in glossary).
'Damatte kiite rya nameta mane shite kureru ja nee ka' -> 'I listened quietly, and you've got the nerve to make a fool of me!'.
Gaddess: it would have been better had Arche come out from the start; 'koko wa makaseta' -> 'I'm leaving this to you'.
'Taishou' = Reborns -> 'the boss', as in story_136 #0.176.

UNCERTAIN: labelled Arche; 'Ee! Gundam-san yoo!!' reads as Ali's sarcastic taunt at Duo right after Duo orders the others after Gaddess. Mocking politeness of '-san' carried as 'Mister Gundam'. Possibly Arche attacking again.

#0.284-298 leader block, variant order from Pt_Chara_Check: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Black RX, Rider 1. Target is Gaddess -> 'her' (glossary g=f). 'Hitsuzu oitsuite miseru' resolve rendered with 'We'll' since the whole party pursues (narration #0.309); identical JP -> identical EN.
Heero's classic 'Combat level, target confirmed.'
Momotaros: 'Yarou!!' as an exclamation at Gaddess -> 'Why, that little...!!' (kept gender-neutral wording; 'nab her' per glossary).
Heavyarms, staying behind with Sandrock and Birth: 'oretachi datte' = we too / even we can buy time.
Birth: 'tokkou sareru yori saki ni' = before the Gaga kamikaze into us -> 'before they can ram us'.

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: #0.282 (labelled Arche; read as Ali's sarcastic 'Mister Gundam' taunt). Leader block #0.284-298 mapped via Pt_Chara_Check order; 'We'll' chosen for pursuit resolve. Not in glossary: Hyper Jammer (Deathscythe's jamming system).
